# 03 - Record codec for the five copybooks

- **Work item:** INT-T03 - A copybook-driven codec decodes and encodes every field of the five layouts in the fixture code page and in EBCDIC, byte for byte.
- **Source:** `Cognition-Partner-Workshops/ts-cobol-carddemo`, baseline `6face58c092d254a9b89ce8bbfbddce561720a40`, stream root INTCALC (`app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl` -> `app/cbl/CBACT04C.cbl`). Branch from `demo/04-design` or its successor.
- **Context:**
  - Rules: INT-T04, INT-T05, INT-T06 (`modernization/rules/interest/rules.yaml`)
  - Architecture: `modernization/design/architecture.md` version 0.1.0. Section Components (record-codec). The pilot's minimal decoding is replaced by this codec behind the same ports.
  - Data-map rows (`modernization/design/data-map-interest.md`): all rows of CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA01Y, CVTRA02Y, CVTRA05Y; encoding rules E1-E6; gaps G01, G02, G03, G05, G07
  - Decisions: REL-08 is open: the EBCDIC code page is a parameter with cp037 as the unconfirmed default
- **Scope:**
  - Allowed files:
    - java/interest/src/main/java/**/codec/**
    - java/interest/src/test/**/codec/**
    - java/interest/src/main/java/**/file/** (the pilot's file adapters, to call the codec)
  - Frozen shared interfaces:
    - FI-1 Record layouts (app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy, CVACT03Y.cpy, CVTRA01Y.cpy, CVTRA02Y.cpy, CVTRA05Y.cpy)
    - FI-2 Recorded output format and comparator (fixtures/interest/&lt;case&gt;/expected (datasets/&lt;DSN&gt;.txt, sysout/INTCALC.STEP15.txt, rc.json, manifest.json) and tools/parity/compare.py)
    - FI-3 Ports of the calculation (java/interest: package com.carddemo.interest.port (BalanceSource, AccountStore, CardLookup, RateLookup, TransactionSink, RunLog))
    - FI-6 Parity entry point (make parity-java [CASE=&lt;case&gt;], output under work/parity-java/&lt;case&gt;/actual)
  - Excluded work:
    - COMP-3 and COMP (rule E5: refuse, do not guess)
    - database access
    - changes to the calculation
- **Dependencies:**
  - ticket 01 (pilot-thin-slice) merged
- **Acceptance:**
  - Input: every record of every file under fixtures/interest/*/input and */expected/datasets. Result: decode then encode returns the identical bytes.
  - Input: the same records translated to cp037 with zoned signs as bytes X'C0'-X'C9' and X'D0'-X'D9'. Result: the decoded values equal those of the fixture code page.
  - Observable values: 0000010000{ decodes to 1000.00 as S9(09)V99; 0000000300} decodes to -30.00 and encodes back to the same 11 bytes; an F-signed digit decodes as positive and encodes with a C sign (G02).
  - Errors: a non-digit in a PIC 9 field, a byte outside the code page in a PIC X field (G07), a record of the wrong length and a field with USAGE other than DISPLAY each raise an error naming file, record number and field.
  - Database assertions: none (no database access in this ticket).
- **Verification:**
  - Build: mvn -q -f java/interest/pom.xml verify
  - Tests: round-trip tests over all fixture files; table-driven tests for E1-E4
  - Fixture case: make parity-java CASE=i01-baseline still passes
  - Final-revision evidence: test summary with the count of records round-tripped per file
- **Deliverables:** one branch and one pull request; the test output named under Verification, pasted or attached to the pull request; a list of gaps - report any fixture record that does not round-trip, with its bytes.
